#!/bin/bash
# Backup /etc/shadow safely
install -b /etc/shadow /etc/shadow.bak

# Determine desired minimum password age from login.defs, default to 1
PASS_MIN_DAYS=$(awk '/^PASS_MIN_DAYS/ {print $2}' /etc/login.defs)
if [[ ! "$PASS_MIN_DAYS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [[ "$PASS_MIN_DAYS" -lt 1 ]]; then
    DESIRED=1
else
    DESIRED=$PASS_MIN_DAYS
fi

LOGFILE="/var/log/password_min_age_remediation.log"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOGFILE")"
: > "$LOGFILE"

# Iterate over regular user accounts (UID >= 1000) excluding root
while IFS=: read -r USERNAME _ UID _ _ _ _; do
    if [[ $UID -ge 1000 && $USERNAME != "root" ]]; then
        # Get current minimum password age (in days)
        CUR_MIN=$(chage -l "$USERNAME" | awk -F: '/Minimum password age/ {gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}')
        [[ -z $CUR_MIN ]] && CUR_MIN=0
        if [[ $CUR_MIN -lt $DESIRED ]]; then
            OLD=$CUR_MIN
            chage -m "$DESIRED" "$USERNAME"
            echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') USER=$USERNAME OLD_MIN=$OLD NEW_MIN=$DESIRED" >> "$LOGFILE"
        fi
    fi
done < /etc/passwd
